hero.desc.0: Precision-engineered evaporators, dryers, CIP systems, heat exchangers, and complete process plants - designed for superior performance in demanding industrial environments.
p.0: Precision-engineered evaporators, dryers, CIP systems, heat exchangers, and complete process plants - designed for superior performance in demanding industrial environments.
p.1: Every unit is designed to your specific process requirements, feed properties, and production targets.
p.2: All equipment meets ASME, IBR, BIS, 3-A, GMP, and other applicable national and international standards.
p.3: Multi-effect evaporation, heat recovery, and MVR upgrades reduce your steam and power consumption significantly.
p.4: Comprehensive after-sales service including spare parts, on-site maintenance, and remote technical support.
p.5: Share your process requirements and our engineering team will develop a customized proposal - including technical specifications, energy analysis, and commercial terms.
prod.desc.0: High-efficiency evaporator ideal for heat-sensitive products. The liquid forms a thin film on tube inner surfaces, enabling gentle and rapid evaporation at low temperatures. Available in single, double, triple, and multi-effect configurations.
prod.desc.1: Designed for viscous, scaling, or crystallizing liquids. Forced circulation ensures high velocity through the heat exchanger tubes, preventing scale deposition and enabling efficient concentration of difficult fluids.
prod.desc.2: Vertical tube evaporator where liquid and vapor rise together through tubes in a climbing film pattern. Suitable for non-viscous, non-scaling liquids requiring gentle treatment at moderate concentrations.
prod.desc.3: Compact, high-efficiency plate-type evaporator with corrugated plate heat exchange surfaces. Excellent thermal performance with low liquid hold-up - ideal for small to medium dairy and food applications.
prod.desc.4: Jacketed vacuum pan evaporator for batch operations requiring precise concentration control. Designed with a vacuum system to reduce boiling point - protecting heat-sensitive products during concentration.
prod.desc.5: Convert liquid feed into free-flowing powder in a single operation. Available in nozzle atomization and rotary disc atomization designs - producing powders with precise particle size distribution for dairy, food, pharma, chemical, and Starch applications.
prod.desc.6: Fluidized bed technology for granular, crystalline, and powdery materials. Provides uniform, gentle drying with precise moisture control - available in continuous configurations for dairy and food.
prod.desc.7: Inert gas or solvent-laden atmosphere dryer for products that cannot be exposed to atmospheric oxygen. Designed for solvent recovery, preventing emission and enabling safe handling of explosive or oxidation-sensitive materials.
prod.desc.8: Continuous dryer for viscous, heat-sensitive, and fouling materials. A rotating blade assembly spreads feed into a thin turbulent film on the heated wall, enabling rapid evaporation under vacuum - ideal for ZLD, effluent salts, and high-value products.
prod.desc.9: Ideal for drying paste, filter cake, sludge, and wet granular materials directly without pre-drying. The spinning action provides intense heat and mass transfer, achieving dry powder in a compact system footprint.
prod.desc.10: Turnkey dairy plant from raw milk reception to final product packaging. Includes all processing equipment - pasteurizer, homogenizer, separator, storage tanks, UHT, and packaging-ready output with CIP integration.
prod.desc.11: Industrial-scale milk chilling plant for rapid and hygienic cooling of large volumes of raw milk received at dairy processing facilities. Integrated refrigeration system with plate heat exchangers, insulated storage silos, and automated temperature monitoring ensures milk reaches 4?C rapidly.
prod.desc.12: High-Temperature Short-Time (HTST) and Low-Temperature Long-Time (LTLT) pasteurizers for safe milk processing. Plate-type heat exchangers ensure precise temperature control, minimal nutritional loss, and extended shelf life.
prod.desc.13: Vacuum deodorizer designed to remove off-flavors, taints, and volatile compounds from milk and dairy products. Improves product quality and shelf life - essential for premium dairy brands and exports.
prod.desc.14: Complete butter processing line including cream separation, pasteurization, aging, and continuous butter-making machine. Designed for high-throughput production of table butter, white butter, and salted butter with precise moisture control and CIP provision.
prod.desc.15: Complete turnkey ghee manufacturing plant covering cream-to-ghee processing, butter melting, clarification, filtration, and filling. Produces ISI-grade pure ghee with consistent color, flavor, and free fatty acid levels. Suitable for large dairy co-operatives and FMCG ghee brands.
prod.desc.16: Industrial-grade stainless steel butter churner for converting cream into butter through continuous or batch churning process. Designed with SS 304/316L contact parts, variable speed drive, and CIP provision for hygienic and efficient butter production.
prod.desc.17: Steam-jacketed ghee clarification kettle for melting and clarifying butter into pure ghee. Designed with SS 316L inner lining, agitator with scraper blades, steam/hot-water jacket, and tilting mechanism for easy discharge and hygienic cleaning.
prod.desc.18: Continuous or batch-type stainless steel khoya (mawa) making machine for concentrating milk solids by evaporation. Equipped with steam-jacketed pan, motorized scraper agitator, and automated temperature control to achieve consistent khoya texture and color.
prod.desc.19: Automated stainless steel milk can conveyor system for efficient handling, transportation, and unloading of milk cans at dairy collection points and processing plants. Reduces manual handling, prevents spillage, and improves throughput with hygienic SS 304 construction and variable-speed drive.
prod.desc.20: Direct expansion (DX) bulk milk cooler for rapid chilling of freshly collected raw milk at village-level milk collection centres (MCC). Cools milk from 35?C to 4?C within 3 hours, preventing bacterial growth and maintaining freshness. Available in open-top and closed-top designs with CIP provision.
prod.desc.21: Jacketed stainless steel crystallization tank for controlled cooling and crystal formation in dairy, food, and chemical processes. Designed with agitator, precise temperature control, and hygienic SS 304/316L construction for uniform crystal size and consistent product quality.
prod.desc.22: Complete effluent treatment plant (ETP) and sewage treatment plant (STP) solutions for industrial and municipal wastewater. Primary, secondary, and tertiary treatment with aeration, clarification, filtration, and sludge handling to meet CPCB discharge norms.
prod.desc.23: Integrated biomass and solid waste treatment plant for agricultural residue, industrial solid waste, and organic rejects. Includes shredding, drying, compaction, and energy recovery for sustainable waste-to-resource conversion.
prod.desc.24: Turnkey biogas plant with anaerobic digester, gas storage, purification, and CNG compression for converting organic waste and biomass into clean fuel. Suitable for dairy waste, food processing rejects, and agricultural biomass.
prod.desc.25: Complete water treatment plants including WTP, ultrafiltration (UF), reverse osmosis (RO), and softener systems for industrial process water, boiler feed, and drinking water with automated backwash and chemical dosing.
prod.desc.26: Wet and dry scrubber systems for removal of particulates, acid gases, VOCs, and odorous compounds from industrial exhaust streams. Custom-designed for boiler flue gas, chemical reactors, and process vent lines.
prod.desc.27: Industrial incinerator systems for safe thermal destruction of hazardous and non-hazardous solid and liquid waste. Primary and secondary combustion chambers with scrubber integration and emission monitoring for CPCB compliance.
prod.desc.28: Heavy-duty industrial heat exchangers designed per TEMA standards. Available in single-pass, multi-pass, U-tube, and fixed tubesheet configurations for heating, cooling, condensing, and preheating applications across all industries.
prod.desc.29: Compact, high-efficiency gasketed plate heat exchangers offering superior thermal performance in minimal footprint. Easy cleaning and maintenance, expandable capacity, ideal for dairy, food, beverage, and HVAC applications.
prod.desc.30: Fully automated Clean-in-Place systems for hygienic cleaning of process lines, tanks, heat exchangers, and equipment without disassembly. PLC-controlled sequences for pre-rinse, caustic wash, acid wash, and final rinse - chemical dosing included.
prod.desc.31: Custom-designed and fabricated pressure vessels for storage and processing of gases and liquids under pressure. Manufactured to ASME Section VIII Div. 1 and IBR standards with full material traceability and NDT testing.
prod.desc.32: Hygienic SS 304/316L storage tanks with mirror-polished internal surfaces, insulation, agitators, CIP spray balls, and level instrumentation. Available in vertical, horizontal, and silos configurations for food, dairy, and pharma applications.
